solar_logic.scope: 判断方法：先看电池片在哪里生产。中国产 → 中国光伏电池令（2012）；台湾产 → 台湾光伏令；柬埔寨/马来西亚/泰国/越南产 → 该国光伏令；印度/印尼/老挝产 → 该国光伏调查；在中国用非中国电池片组装的组件 → 中国光伏产品令（2015）。组件在哪里组装一般不改变结论。
solar_logic.scope_en: How to decide: start from where the cell was produced. China → China solar cell orders (2012); Taiwan → Taiwan solar order; Cambodia / Malaysia / Thailand / Vietnam → that country's solar orders; India / Indonesia / Laos → that country's solar investigation; modules assembled in China from non-Chinese cells → China solar products orders (2015). Where the module is assembled generally does not change the answer.
solar_logic.source: 据上列征税令范围整理

solar_open.scope: 待核：在中国用台湾、柬埔寨/马来西亚/泰国/越南或印度/印尼/老挝电池片组装的组件，按文字可能同时落入中国光伏产品令（2015）和电池片所在国的令，CBP 执行口径未见明确说明。
solar_open.scope_en: Open point: a module assembled in China from Taiwanese, Cambodian, Malaysian, Thai, Vietnamese, Indian, Indonesian or Lao cells may, on the wording, fall under both the China solar products orders (2015) and the orders on the cell country; CBP practice has not been confirmed.

solar_circumvention.label: 中国光伏电池令：柬埔寨/马来西亚/泰国/越南反规避（2023）
solar_circumvention.label_en: China solar cell orders: Cambodia / Malaysia / Thailand / Vietnam anti-circumvention (2023)
solar_circumvention.scope: 在柬埔寨/马来西亚/泰国/越南用中国硅片制成的电池片，以及用这类电池片组装、且六类辅材（银浆、铝框、玻璃、背板、EVA、接线盒）中超过两类为中国产的组件，按中国光伏电池令（2012）征收；进口商和出口商可凭证明免除。
solar_circumvention.scope_en: Cells made in Cambodia, Malaysia, Thailand or Vietnam from Chinese wafers, and modules made from such cells with more than two of six Chinese components (silver paste, frames, glass, backsheets, EVA, junction boxes), are treated as goods under the China solar cell orders (2012); importers and exporters may certify out.
